findings.title: How the live open rows are priced
The deployed freshness copy matches the served snapshot
findings.detail: Snapshot `2026-10-21T21:48:39.360126Z` is 0.06 h old at read time and the strip says stale=False, so the copy and the data agree. Client-side expiry hook (assets/app.js `live-expired` + #runtime-stale) ships, so a row whose deadline passes while the page is open is re-expired in the browser.
